from: cardan-cms-statamic: an AJAX post of the contact form (resources/blueprints/forms/contact.yaml; cardan-cms-nuxt PageBlockForm sends X-Requested-With) with empty required fields. Statamic's FrontendFormRequest::failedValidation and FormController::formFailure answer 400 with every message in `errors` (a list of strings) and each field's first message in `error`; the fields are named by their display name, the sentences are English (APP_LOCALE=en), no Content-Language
